title: 105-20261: Online homework...NEW
content: 105-20261: Online homework...NEWDear Students, The online homework system for PHYS 105 in the Fall 2026 semester will be administered through the course [PHYS 105 ALL SECTIONS] General Physics I – Fall 2026. Students who wish to earn bonus points by completing online homework assignments must create a Pearson account by following the announced registration procedure. The course has already been opened, and the following two assignments are currently available: Introduction to MasteringPhysics Physics Primer These two assignments are intended to familiarize students with the online homework system. They will remain available until December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM, and their scores will not be included in the homework grade calculation. The first graded homework assignment, HW-01, will contain questions from the topics covered in class in Chapter 2 of the textbook. It will become available on Sunday, October 11, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The opening date, due date, and availability period of each homework assignment will be clearly indicated. I wish you all success in the course. Dr. Mustafa ÖzbakanOn behalf of the PHYS 105 Course Instructors
